_meta.description: Frozen vocabulary for Mukuru Detection. Do not rename or remove codes without updating all i18n files and the risk engine. Add new codes only with a spec change.

SUSPICIOUS_LINK.description: Message contains a link that matches a known malicious or suspicious domain

REQUESTS_OTP_PIN.description: Message asks the recipient to share an OTP, PIN, or password

URGENCY_LANGUAGE.description: Message uses urgent language to pressure immediate action

IMPERSONATION.description: Message impersonates a known bank, courier, government body, or service

MOVE_TO_WHATSAPP.description: Message asks the recipient to continue the conversation on WhatsApp

ASKS_FOR_MONEY.description: Message directly or indirectly requests a money transfer or fee payment

FAKE_JOB_OFFER.description: Message offers a job, salary, or work-from-home opportunity with suspicious conditions

ADVANCE_FEE.description: Message requests an upfront fee to release funds, a prize, or an inheritance

ROMANCE_SCAM.description: Message uses romantic or emotional language to build trust before requesting money

LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN.description: Message contains a domain name very similar to a known legitimate domain

SHORTENED_URL.description: Message contains a shortened URL that hides the actual destination

PHONE_IN_MESSAGE.description: Message contains a phone number different from the sender, typically used to redirect communication

GENERIC_GREETING.description: Message uses a generic greeting like 'Dear Customer' instead of the recipient's name

EMAIL_MISMATCH.description: Email sender address and reply-to address do not match

DISPLAY_NAME_SPOOF.description: Email display name matches a known brand but the sending domain does not

NEW_RECIPIENT.description: Recipient has not received a transfer from this user in the past 90 days

UNUSUAL_AMOUNT.description: Amount is more than twice the user's average send amount over the past 90 days

ROUND_LARGE_AMOUNT.description: Amount is a large round number (≥ R500 / USD 50 and divisible by 100)

RAPID_REPEAT_SENDS.description: Three or more sends to the same recipient in the past 24 hours

AFTER_RISKY_MESSAGE.description: A HIGH_RISK message scan was recorded for this user in the past 30 minutes

NEW_COUNTRY.description: Destination country has not been used in this user's transaction history

DO_NOT_SHARE_PIN.description: Never share your PIN, OTP, or password with anyone

DO_NOT_PAY_UPFRONT.description: Legitimate employers and prize schemes never ask for upfront fees

VERIFY_SENDER.description: Call the organisation directly using the number on their official website

DO_NOT_CLICK_LINK.description: Do not click the link; type the address directly into your browser

PAUSE_AND_CONFIRM.description: Pause this transaction and confirm the recipient's identity before sending

REPORT_SCAM.description: Report this message to your bank or the South African Banking Risk Information Centre (SABRIC)

TRUST_YOUR_INSTINCTS.description: If something feels wrong, stop and talk to someone you trust before continuing

BLOCK_AND_REPORT.description: Block this sender and report the message as spam

CHECK_URL.description: Check the web address carefully — scammers use addresses that look almost right
